Learned AGA and Special Land Acquisition Officer, Seabird, Karwar, have filed a memo dated 19.08.2020, seeking leave to withdraw the appeal as the award amount has already been released and same has been satisfied.
The said memo is taken on record.
Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as withdrawn.
